metadata_phrases.Geocoding Artifact Address Primary X Coo: primary longitude in decimal degrees (x coordinate) of an entity based on its address
metadata_phrases.Geocoding Artifact Address Primary Y Coo: primary latitude in decimal degrees (y coordinate) of an entity based on its address
metadata_phrases.BPHC Assigned Number: site number assigned by the source system
metadata_phrases.Site Status Description: whether a given health center service delivery site is affiliated with an organization that has a current health center grant, and that the site itself is currently open for business
metadata_phrases.Health Center Type Description: indicates whether a given health center service delivery site offers direct patient care, functions in an administrative capacity, or both
metadata_phrases.Data Warehouse Record Create Date: the date on which the data was processed by the HRSA Data Warehouse

vocabulary_notes: HRSA metadata valid values (2016/05/27 and 2015/05/15 definitions) omit 'Transitional Care in Carceral Setting', 'Health Center/Applicant', and 'Subrecipient', which appear in the live file; they were reviewed from the 2026-11-14 file. Any other unreviewed value holds the candidate.

exposed_attributes.county_fips: State and County Federal Information Processing Standard Code

not_exposed_notes: Site Added to Scope this Date is marked Restricted in HRSA metadata and is never exposed. Medicare billing/NPI numbers, congressional and senator fields, and organization (awardee) address fields are retained only in the raw staging record.

location_policy.crs_basis: HRSA metadata defines X/Y as longitude/latitude in decimal degrees from Esri address geocoding; no datum is stated. Coordinates are stored exactly as published and interpreted as WGS 84 longitude/latitude without transformation.
location_policy.source_quality_fields: none published (no geocode match score, precision, or method field)
rules: suppressed_source_policy: location setting is Domestic Violence. HRSA suppresses street, building number, and ZIP for these shelters; no coordinate, address, or phone is stored in the read model or exposed, even if present in the file.
no_published_coordinates: X and Y both blank.
invalid_coordinates: only one of X/Y present, nonnumeric, nonfinite, outside longitude -180..180 or latitude -90..90, or exactly 0,0.

approximate_shared_coordinate: identical published X/Y is shared by sites whose normalized city names differ, or a pair published with at most three decimal places is shared by sites whose normalized street addresses differ (a place-level geocode).
coarse_coordinate: X or Y published with at most two decimal places (about 1 km or coarser).
published_county_not_in_boundary_layer: the site's state is covered by the CHIP TIGER/Line 2024 county layer but its published county FIPS is blank or absent from that layer.
outside_published_county: the point does not intersect the TIGER/Line 2024 county whose GEOID equals the site's published county FIPS.
mapped: none of the above. boundary_check is within_published_county, or outside_chip_boundary_layer for island areas (AS, GU, MP, VI, FM, MH, PW) that the CHIP 2024 layer does not cover.
location_policy.never: No address is geocoded, no withheld location is reconstructed, and no city, ZIP, or county centroid is substituted for a missing site location.

boundary.vintage: TIGER/Line 2024 county equivalents (50 states, DC, Puerto Rico)

clustering.note: Clusters are display groupings of eligible published sites in a fixed Web Mercator grid cell for the current zoom. They are not service areas, catchments, or travel-time zones.

limitations: Current HRSA directory snapshot, not an annual observation period. HRSA refreshes it daily; CHIP shows the reviewed snapshot named here.
Sites differ in services, hours, and who they serve; this file does not list services offered or whether a site accepts new patients.
School, hospital, nursing-home, correctional, and carceral-setting sites may serve only students, residents, or patients of that institution.
Mobile van locations are the published base address, not every place the van operates.
Domestic violence shelter locations are suppressed by HRSA and are never mapped. Sites without published coordinates or with approximate coordinates are counted but not mapped.
Clusters are display groupings, not service areas. CHIP does not calculate service areas, travel times, nearest providers, rates, or clinical performance.
